title: Obtain Guest Special Event accounts
resolution_html:
• Sponsored Guest Accounts - Access for guest-staff and guest-faculty can be requested by a manager (or above) or a faculty member using Sponsored Account Form
  • Free Guest WiFi -The AirYorkGuest service is available to anyone visiting the York campus and is not normally part of the University community, such as academic guests or colleagues, or external contractors/service vendors.  More information is available about the AirYorkGuest service here>>
  • Special Event Accounts - Temporary wireless internet, computer lab access, or residence internet access can be activated for attendees to an event on campus (e.g. a conference). There is an applicable charge per account - $5. per day, $10. per week, $30. per month. A manager (or above) or a faculty member can complete the Temporary Account form and include:
    • the details of your event
    • the type of accounts you require (e.g. wireless, lab workstations)
    • the start and end date of the event
    • the number of accounts you require
    • a budget number
